title: Treasure Island Mixer
description: Event showcase section with offset image (black accent, image-left), heading, description, feature badges, and CTA. Used for the Treasure Island Mixer.

description.default:
Following the Nordic Fund Day stage programme, you are exclusively invited aboard the ship taking us all to the Secret and beautiful Treasure Island Mixer.

Here, you will enjoy facilitated matchmaking with fellow investors and stakeholders, alongside compelling scale-ups and startups, in an informal, vibrant, and enjoyable setting designed to encourage dialogue, meaningful connections, and new opportunities.

Enjoy the experience.
